diagnostic_interpretation: F1 = F11 + F12 reconciles within 0.1 million RON wherever all three published series are available.
Published S12 and S121 F1 liabilities are non-zero around the 2021 SDR allocation and are entirely F12/SDR in the retained diagnostic; F11 liability is zero.
The very large residuals in the exploratory corrected-applicability re-audit are explained by omitting those published F12 liabilities.
The W1 asset-side comparisons match S121 F1/F11/F12 exactly in the retained diagnostic, so the exploratory failure is not evidence for a wholesale W1 orientation swap.

These findings invalidate the post-run resident-liability structural-zero proposal but do not change the historical Phase B/C/D outcomes, which were generated under the earlier source-required contract.
